notes.key_messages:
To maximise their chances of success on this paper, candidates should:
(cid:127) read all instructions, questions and texts very carefully
(cid:127) answer comprehension questions in French with brief but focused answers – where only a single line
space is provided, short answers are expected
(cid:127) make sure that they have answered every part of every question, including multiple choice
(cid:127) make any alterations to an answer clear
(cid:127) allow themselves time to check their work, particularly spellings, verb agreements, and words copied
from the text.
notes.general_comments:
This Reading paper followed the revised syllabus format. Candidates dealt confidently with the variety of
reading comprehension exercise types, including the new gap-filling task in Section 2. All candidates
seemed to have ample time to complete the paper. The paper offered an appropriate challenge and a
gradient of difficulty. The standard of presentation and legibility was generally good.
